name: Tsukubusuma Shrine
text: Tsukubusuma Shrine (都久夫須麻神社, Tsukubusuma Jinja) is a Shinto shrine on Chikubu Island in Shiga Prefecture, Japan. Its main hall (本殿, honden) is a National Treasure of Japan. The shrine's main festival is held annually on June 15.

depictions.name: Tsukubusuma Shrine
depictions.text: Tsukubusuma Shrine is a Shinto shrine on Chikubushima in Ōmi, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the shrine when they arrived on the island.
